implemented_on_integration: 50 public-source definitions: 45 hourly and three weekly CFTC sources scheduled; two non-commercial public XRPL node endpoints excluded by default.
Read-only main-only scheduled ingestion workflow; not present on main and no scheduled main run verified.
Raw-source SHA-256 receipts, allowlisted HTTP provenance headers and local cross-run receipt-chain prototype.
SQLite point-in-time feature store with append-only SQL triggers and store-receipt-time as-of checks.
Event timeline, scenarios and counter-hypotheses; registry is curated and not an automatically discovered event feed.
Four deterministic baselines: naive class prior, momentum sign, mean-reversion sign and volatility normal.
Purged chronological walk-forward evaluation; ingestion passes embargo_seconds equal to the target horizon, 100 training samples and 100 OOS samples.
Temporal temperature calibration, paired block bootstrap, PSI drift diagnostics and source-independence groups.
Fail-closed forecast ledger requiring verified point-in-time feature snapshots and external Ed25519 evaluator attestation.
limitations: SQLite triggers are not adversarially tamper-proof; a database owner can replace the file or remove triggers.
GitHub Actions raw artifacts retain 90 days, per-run feature-store checkpoints seven days, and daily feature archives 90 days; no independent WORM store or trusted timestamp authority exists.
Source-independence groups are curated heuristics, not independently authenticated publisher identities.
No trained XRP-specific candidate model exists.
No candidate has demonstrated out-of-sample superiority against all four baselines.
No sufficiently mature synchronized multi-venue historical L2/derivatives/flows/collateral dataset exists.

institutional_network_addendum.cross_network_conclusion: SBI's digital-asset strategy is explicitly multi-rail: RLUSD and USDC distribution, JPYSC, Circle Arc, Open Standard/OUSD, Solana, XDC, Canton and tokenized-fund partnerships. These initiatives show institutional stablecoin and tokenized-asset activity but do not imply that XRP is required for their settlement. The SBI VC Trade RLUSD product's Ethereum-only network support at launch is a direct counterexample to assuming every SBI-RLUSD relationship creates XRPL liquidity.
